race.comment: XCEPTIONAL SPIRIT (6) is the one to beat on the strength of her placing at this track two starts back, where she began awkwardly, led and was still beaten just under two lengths in a Class 1. Her Orange run last start was only fair after leading and fading in a BM50, but the beaten margin was just over three lengths and the weight relief helps her rebound. MORE STYLISH (9) resumes from over a year away and brings a readiness pointer after winning an easy trial at Queanbeyan. The new 900m trip is the query, yet her overall record is stronger than most in this field. ALABAMA HAMMER (1) comes back from provincial BM64 company after a first-up third at Newcastle and is already proven at this distance, although the top weight keeps some pressure on. MEDIA COVERAGE (8) is race fit, backs up after winning a BM50 at Tumut and had earlier finished close up at Orange, so he profiles as a genuine place threat stepping into harder company. The chances don't end there.
